name: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk is an Indonesian enterprise primarily engaged in the extraction of copper and gold. The company holds significant stakes in the Batu Hijau mine and the Elang project, both situated on Sumbawa Island. Beyond its core mining operations, it also supplies specialized technical and professional personnel to its various mining and support divisions, alongside offering human resource management solutions. Furthermore, the company is involved in the construction and operation of purification facilities for copper concentrate and anode-sludge. Its diversified portfolio also includes investments in real estate and hospitality ventures. Established in 2015, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in South Jakarta, Indonesia.
